summary: Backend-only testing of the new /api/spike/run endpoint (Browserbase + Playwright CDP + Cloudinary + MongoDB). Executed 9 pytest tests — all passed. One real Browserbase session was consumed. Verified: (1) spike returns run with outcome=success, target=https://tier3.college, browserbase_session_id; (2) step contains cloudinary screenshot URL (HEAD 200), accessibility_tree with node_count > 0, console_errors + failed_requests arrays; (3) run and step are persisted in MongoDB and visible via GET /api/runs and GET /api/steps?run_id=...; (4) SpikeRunRequest defaults target_url to https://tier3.college for empty body; (5) prior CRUD (health, persona-panels, runs create/delete) still works.

minor.issue: Returns 500 on any internal failure (HTTPException wraps str(e)); consider mapping Browserbase/Cloudinary/Playwright timeouts to 502/504 with structured error body for the caller.
browser.close() in finally does not release the Browserbase session explicitly; a session leak is possible on unexpected errors. Consider bb.sessions.update(status='REQUEST_RELEASE') on error paths.

action_items: Optional: return structured error payload (not just str(e)) from POST /api/spike/run to help the FE surface Browserbase vs Cloudinary vs Playwright failures.
Optional: explicitly release the Browserbase session on failure paths in spike.py to avoid quota leaks.
critical_code_review_comments: spike.py is well-structured and separates concerns (session creation, browser job, cloudinary upload, persistence). Only concern is error-path resource cleanup (session not explicitly released).

The extra fields written to MongoDB (browserbase_session_id on runs; accessibility_tree/console_errors/page_errors/failed_requests on steps) are NOT modeled by Run/Step Pydantic models — verified GET /api/runs and GET /api/steps still return valid docs because Pydantic silently drops unknown fields. This is by design for the spike but worth noting when persona work is added.
server.py continues to grow (573 lines) — recommend splitting models.py / routes/ before next feature.
spike.execute_spike_run has no per-step retry or backoff on transient Browserbase 429/5xx; acceptable for a spike.
seed_data_creation: Spike created 1 run + 1 step in MongoDB. Not cleaned up (kept as evidence). Run id and step id visible in spike_results.xml log if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Spike tests share one Browserbase session per module (fixture scope='module'). To rerun sparingly, use `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_spike.py -n 0`. Each full run consumes 1 Browserbase session + 1 Cloudinary upload. The spike endpoint takes ~10-15s; timeout is set to 180s in tests. /app/backend/pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope; pass -n 0 for serial execution.
